answer.rationale: The scenario describes a mechanical integrity inspection under PSM finding process equipment (pressure vessel) outside acceptable limits defined by process safety information. §1910.119(j)(4) requires documented inspections/tests of process equipment, and §1910.119(j)(5) directly requires the employer to correct deficiencies in equipment outside acceptable limits before further use or in a safe and timely manner. These requirements are clearly triggered by the facts given.
